scope: Finite N=6 full Floquet-Lindblad topology controls. This protocol tests whether a fixed physical preparation produces boundary-condition and drive-class-dependent TLS spectra. It does not claim a thermodynamic-limit phase diagram or universal edge spectroscopy.

scientific_separation.gate_A_question: With a common physical initial state independent of Floquet eigenvectors, does the full chain-TLS response at an edge contact differ reproducibly between topological OBC, same-drive PBC, and trivial OBC?
scientific_separation.gate_B_question: Conditional on a fixed physical initial state, how much of that state is retained by a Floquet manifold and when does a K=2/K=4 local reduction reproduce the full response?
prohibited_in_gate_A: Selecting a Floquet pair to define the full-model initial state
Using arg(<phi_a|Z_m|phi_b>) to set a full-model initial-state phase
Copying numerical Floquet indices across drives or boundary conditions
Calling the absence of a selected pair an absence of physical response

physical_initial_state.TLS_state: |0_d><0_d|, the Z_d=+1 basis state used in the production scripts
physical_initial_state.independence_declaration: The full-model initial state is fixed before and is independent of alpha, beta, boundary condition, Floquet eigensystem, B^(0), any selected pair, and any numerical Floquet index.

controls.execution_gate: Run only after the three primary controls are complete and the prospectively fixed primary criterion passes.

probe_contacts.boundary_note: For PBC, m=0 is a reference contact with the same numerical location as OBC; m=3 is the fixed diametrically separated bulk reference.

full_model_measurement_protocol.phasor_readout: A_TLS(r)=abs[2/(t_f-t_dis) integral_{t_dis}^{t_f}(c_d(t)-mean(c_d)) exp(+i Omega t/2) dt]

frozen_analysis_definitions.raw_spectrum: a_i=A_TLS(r_i) on the listed ratio grid
frozen_analysis_definitions.angular_frequency_spectral_weight: W_omega(a)=trapezoid(|a_i|^2,omega_i), with omega_i=r_i*Omega/2; it is reported but not used for cross-drive decisions because the matched drive periods differ.
frozen_analysis_definitions.peak_position: r_i at the largest raw-spectrum grid value; ties are reported, not broken.
frozen_analysis_definitions.resolved_splitting: Reported only if two strict interior local maxima are separated by >=2 grid intervals and both are >=0.70 of the global maximum; otherwise status=not_resolved_on_frozen_grid.
frozen_analysis_definitions.linewidth: For the global maximum, linear-interpolation FWHM is reported only when half-height crossings occur on both sides inside the frozen grid; otherwise status=censored_by_grid.

prospective_primary_decision_rule.purpose: A finite-system, deterministic criterion for whether the three primary controls justify proceeding to the held-out drive. These values are protocol choices, not universal physical constants.
prospective_primary_decision_rule.pass: All six inequalities pass, every full-model output has valid finite readout values, and no full-model response was conditioned on a Floquet pair.
prospective_primary_decision_rule.inconclusive_or_fail: If any inequality fails, or a diagnostic is undefined, Gate A v2 does not authorize a topological-TLS-spectroscopy claim. The result must be reported as finite-system evidence against, or insufficient for, the proposed specificity under this fixed preparation.
prospective_primary_decision_rule.heldout_requirement: A held-out topological OBC point must reproduce the direction of all three primary contrasts against its predeclared matching controls before any stronger manuscript language is considered.

gate_B_reduced_model_protocol.separation_from_gate_A: Gate B is executed only after Gate A full-model outputs. It never changes Gate A initial states or full-model spectra.
gate_B_reduced_model_protocol.Floquet_manifold: Use the pre-existing physical local near-pi channel ranking only to construct P_K; report all numerical Floquet indices as backend-specific metadata.
gate_B_reduced_model_protocol.retained_weight: p_K=Tr(P_K rho_chain(0)) for K=2 and K=4, evaluated before reduced propagation.
gate_B_reduced_model_protocol.projected_initial_state: rho_K(0)=P_K rho_chain(0) P_K/p_K if p_K>1e-12; otherwise the reduced response is declared undefined rather than normalized artificially.
gate_B_reduced_model_protocol.interpretation: Small p_K or failure of K=4 after projection is physical evidence that the existing reduced model is restricted to selected pair-coherence preparations; it is not a software failure.

before_any_v2_full_run: Commit this finalized protocol and implementation to the public repository.
Record immutable protocol_sha256, git_commit, repository URL and UTC run start time in every result JSON.
after_each_run: Record UTC finish time, Python/NumPy/SciPy versions, script_sha256, exact command, and output-file sha256 in the result JSON.
Do not overwrite prior output directories; use a protocol-hash-qualified directory.

documentation_delivery.canonical_format: Markdown with embedded/linked PNG and PDF figures plus JSON data and source scripts.
documentation_delivery.docx_policy: No DOCX is a deliverable for this protocol. If a DOCX is later requested, create it from the verified Markdown source and perform a visual validation before release.
